title: P3 Chinese
description: Primary 3 Chinese (Singapore MOE 2024 syllabus, 欢乐伙伴): the 15-lesson word catalogue with pinyin and meanings, Paper 2 technique section by section, oral and composition. English-first explanations around Chinese content, picture word cards.

archetypes.pattern: 辨字: same-sound or same-component distractors for one target character inside a lesson word
词语选择: connector choice, request verbs, 准-family
看图选词: concrete noun or action with a clear picture
组句成段: a 5–7 sentence everyday story; connectors 首先/接着/最后/有一次/这一天 and pronoun back-references give the order
扩写: insert an adjective/adverb phrase; add 结果/因为
组合: 如果…就 · 虽然…但是 · 只要…就 · 或者 · 却 · merge three 的 descriptions
仿写: 把字句; 虽然…但是 modelled sentence
阅读理解一: animal fable or child-at-home story, 3 MCQ
理解问答: a family, helping-at-home or holiday passage; describe (copy), why (因为…), 从哪里可以看出 (quote), what next (opinion)
作文: 4 pictures: a problem, a consequence, help or a realisation, a resolution; a personal-responsibility theme

references.title: Word catalogue: Lessons 1–15
sections: 第一课　(Lesson 1) — School life, effort and achievement (努力、练习、成功)
第二课　(Lesson 2) — Names, surnames and describing people (姓名、外貌)
第三课　(Lesson 3) — Morning routine, habits and being on time (闹钟、迟到、习惯)
第四课　(Lesson 4) — Change and growth — opposites like 深浅、宽窄 (变化)
第五课　(Lesson 5) — Outings: exhibitions, shopping, newspapers and magazines (傍晚、报刊、付钱)
第六课　(Lesson 6) — Mistakes, apologising and forgiving (错误、原谅、扶起来)
第七课　(Lesson 7) — Breaking things, paying back, resting when sick (赔、道歉、休息)
第八课　(Lesson 8) — Celebrations, clothes, hard work and sweat (贺、裙裤、汗)
第九课　(Lesson 9) — Animal stories, rescue and measuring (救、称、夸)
第十课　(Lesson 10) — Litter and protecting the environment (垃圾、环境)
第十一课　(Lesson 11) — Reusable bags, plastic and responsibility (环保袋、代替、责任)
第十二课　(Lesson 12) — Singapore flag, National Day, races of Singapore (国旗、国庆、民族)
第十三课　(Lesson 13) — Nature trips: lake, forest, beach, map (湖、森林、沙滩、地图)
第十四课　(Lesson 14) — Animal fable: strong/weak, lazy, salty/bland (强弱、懒、咸淡)
第十五课　(Lesson 15) — Fear, pain, bravery — a classroom story (吓、痛、勇敢、简单)
